findings: The candidate is bounded to the preserved LC490 source and the official rolling-ball semantics.
It correctly models stopping positions, not every traversed cell, as search states.
The exact Java BFS only succeeds when destination is a reachable stopping state; pass-through without a stop is rejected.
BFS is presented as a reachability traversal rather than incorrectly justified as shortest-path search; DFS is correctly identified as an equivalent reachability traversal.
The conservative direct-scan bound O(mn(m+n)) and O(mn) auxiliary space are explicitly qualified, with transition precomputation identified as the optimization boundary.

Independent execution covers five fixed semantic cases, exhaustive 3x3 maze masks over all open endpoint pairs, and 5000 seeded random mazes against a separately precomputed stop-transition reference; no mismatch or input mutation was found.
The project section stays hypothetical and does not fabricate production experience.
